title: Markdoc language server configuration
description: Configuration for @markdoc/language-server. An array of site configurations. This plugin uses only the first entry.

id.description: Identifier that uniquely identifies this configuration. Shown as the diagnostic source (markdoc:<id>).

path.description: Directory that contains the Markdoc files, relative to the project root. Defaults to the project root.

root.description: Ignored: this plugin always replaces it with the project root.

directory.description: Directory that contains the partials, relative to the project root (for example markdoc/partials).

partialPaths.description: How the file attribute of {% partial %} is resolved (specific to this plugin). "content" (default): relative to the content directory (path), as in the upstream language server. "relative": as in Astro (@astrojs/markdoc): ./ and ../ from the file that contains the tag, / from the project root, aliases from compilerOptions.paths in tsconfig.json, and other paths from the file that contains the tag. {"directory": "..."}: as in @markdoc/next.js: relative to the given directory, including paths that start with /. Partials outside the project root are not resolved.

contentPaths.description: Directories to scan for Markdoc documents, relative to the project root (specific to this plugin). When set, they are scanned instead of path. Inside them, files with an extension in markdocExtensions are also treated as Markdoc. node_modules, .next and .git are never scanned.

markdocExtensions.description: Extensions (for example ".md") that are treated as Markdoc inside contentPaths, or inside path when contentPaths is not set (specific to this plugin). .mdoc, .markdoc and *.markdoc.md are always treated as Markdoc.

frontmatterVariable.description: Name of a variable that holds the frontmatter of the document, in addition to $markdoc.frontmatter (specific to this plugin). Astro passes it as <Content frontmatter={entry.data} />, so use "frontmatter" there.

ignoreUndefinedVariables.description: Do not report "Undefined variable" (specific to this plugin). Useful when variables are passed at render time, as with Astro's <Content /> props. Astro also ignores this error when it builds.

server.description: Custom language server for the Visual Studio Code extension. Ignored by this plugin.

path.description: Path to a custom server module, relative to the project root.

watch.description: Restart the server when the module (true) or the files matching this glob (string) change.

templates.description: Templates for the Visual Studio Code extension's "New file from template" command. Ignored by this plugin.

pattern.description: Glob that matches the template files.

preview.description: Enable the preview of the Visual Studio Code extension. Ignored by this plugin.

watch.description: Declared by the language server but not used. Ignored by this plugin.

schema.description: Location of the Markdoc schema and how to load it.

path.description: Path to the schema module, relative to the project root. With type "nextjs", the schema directory (for example markdoc).

type.description: Module format of the schema: "node" loads it with require (module.exports), "esm" with import. When omitted, it is loaded as "esm". "nextjs" (specific to this plugin) reads path as a schema directory of @markdoc/next.js: tags, nodes, functions and config (files or folders with index, .js/.jsx/.ts/.tsx and more) are combined into {tags, nodes, functions, ...config}. TypeScript and JSX are converted with sucrase, and React, Next.js, stylesheets and images are replaced with stubs.

property.description: Name of the exported property that contains the schema. When omitted, the whole module.exports (node) or the default export (esm) is used. Ignored with type "nextjs".

watch.description: Reload the schema automatically when the file changes. With type "nextjs", the files that the schema loaded and the schema directory are checked.

frontmatter.description: Name of the frontmatter property that holds the route of each document.

markdoc.description: Options passed to the Markdoc tokenizer (markdown-it options).

allowIndentation.description: Allow tags and Markdown blocks to be indented by 4 spaces or more without becoming code blocks.

typographer.description: Enable markdown-it typographic replacements and smart quotes.

validateFunctions.description: Has no effect here: Markdoc reads validateFunctions from validation in the schema (config.validation.validateFunctions).
validateFunctions.deprecationMessage: Has no effect. Set validation.validateFunctions in the Markdoc schema instead.
